Sattampillai avargal has translated all 150 Psalms in the Bible to Tamil in Poetic language and set to tune to be sung in Church worship, House worship and Personal worship.
Memorizing songs is easier than memorizing Bible verses. Keep singing these songs everyday to have the Bible verses etched in your memory.
Here are a few reasons to sing Psalms:
1. Sing of freedom - Psalm 68:6
2. Sing of God’s love - Psalm 89:1
3. Sing of what God has done - Psalm 132:9
4. Sing for joy - Psalm 132:9
5. Sing for your whole life - Psalm 104:33
6. Sing a new song - Isaiah 42:10
7. Sing in times of trouble - Acts 16:25
8. Sing with gratitude - Colossians 3:16
9 Sing with understanding - 1 Corinthians 14:15
10. Sing from the heart - Ephesians 5:19
